HAIR UP: ALL of her glossy pure BLACK hair (never brown) is swept UP and gathered into the tall high chignon on top of her head under the crown, smooth at the nape; NO hair hanging loose down her back or over her shoulders. SLEEVES: very long, very wide, flowing sleeves that fall well past her hands and hang PAST her ankles all the way down until they TOUCH THE FLOOR, ONE single sleeve layer (no shorter outer sleeve on top); the brocade flows and drapes softly like heavy silk, never stiff. FABRIC: thick gold-embroidered brocade with a graceful, flowing drape. COLOUR RULE: all colours fresh, clear and luminous, never dusty or greyed; the royal golden yellow is the DOMINANT colour of the robe, mantle, sleeves and skirt (more than half of everything visible), black silk richly embroidered with gold thread (the yellow clearly more than the black) is the second colour (collar, inner robe, wide borders and a few panels); the yellow is rich warm royal golden yellow, a honey-gold close to hex #EFBD69 (medium depth, 18K gold tone), not pale cream, not beige/tan/ochre, not heavy mustard, not lemon; the crown, hairpin and jewellery gold in the same 18K tone; gold only as thin accents on the borders; NOT an all-yellow robe. All flowers, birds and the dragon are fine silk-thread embroidery stitched directly into the fabric, flat and integrated with the cloth, following its folds, not appliqué, not pasted patches, not raised. The silk has real weight: the wide sleeves and robe hang and fold naturally under their own weight, with natural creases, never stiff, flat or board-like. Pose: calm standing pose; she holds a round fan of deep crimson silk embroidered with gold dragons, handle of gold carved with dragons, with crimson-and-gold dragon tassels in a contrasting colour, not the robe colour, the item held below the chin, the hand really gripping it, the whole face fully visible. Her hands and body: the round fan held up in one hand at chest height, gently turned to show its painting, the other hand lightly touching its tassel. Every hairpin is inserted into the hair pointing upward or backward with dangles hanging down, no hairpin horizontal or sticking out to the side. prompt: Semi-realistic painterly guofeng portrait style, near-3D realistic rendering with soft natural light and fine detail, exactly matching the rendering of the reference portraits; full-body standing figure head to feet, centered, plain light parchment background, soft even light; fair porcelain skin; gentle expression with soft eyes and a bright closed-lip smile, lips closed, no teeth, mouth never open; elegant, slim, clearly adult; beautiful/handsome romantic-lead looks for everyone; face clearly visible, 3/4 or frontal view. An imperial consort, the Empress. Her face: oval face, almond eyes, long soft lashes. From the identity reference keep ONLY her face, facial features, hairstyle colour and signature colour family; do NOT copy the outfit, hair ornaments or accessories of the reference, dress her in the NEW outfit below. about 22, youthful adult. Outfit (the Empress (Hoàng hậu), clearly much richer and more splendid than the lower ranks): the Empress's imperial dragon ceremonial robe of golden yellow silk mixed with deep wine-crimson, richly embroidered on the chest, shoulders and wide sleeves with large dragons, peonies and clouds in gold and kingfisher-blue silk thread (far denser and richer embroidery than any other rank), over it a long ceremonial silk mantle falling from the shoulders to the floor, edged with a broad band of gold brocade and pearls, a wide jewelled gold-and-pearl cloud collar with layered pearl fringes over the shoulders, many long strands of pearls and jade across the chest, a jade-and-gold belt with long tassels and jade pendants, floor-length robe with slippers visible, slim tall silhouette; the GRANDEST headdress of all: a FULL tall imperial nine-dragon crown, clearly taller and wider than a noble consort's crown, with a large central gold dragon holding a pearl string in its beak, jewelled wings spreading wide on both sides, kingfisher-blue inlay, rubies and pearls, and a few clean pearl tassels at the sides; the most splendid outfit of all, clearly grander than every other rank. NỮ ĐẾ: she is the Female Emperor (Nữ đế), the highest rank of all, equal to the Empress in colour but clearly more majestic, and different in design from the Empress's robe: a woman's imperial ceremonial dragon robe, with a STIFF, SHORT, structured shoulder piece (cầu vai cứng) of gold brocade edged with pearls over each shoulder, slightly pointed outward; her crown is one splendid imperial gold crown of TWO coiled gold dragons facing each other over a large central pearl on a tall gold crown band, gold cloud scrolls rising behind them, set with rubies, pearls and kingfisher-blue inlay, pure gold metalwork with no flowers and no flower ornaments anywhere on the crown or the hairpins, and a few gold hairpins with slim gold-and-pearl dangles at the sides, and a row of bead tassels (lưu) hanging in front from the rim of the crown to the forehead, ending above the eyebrows, the bare forehead clean under them; the most majestic outfit of all. HAIR UP: ALL of her glossy pure BLACK hair (never brown) is swept UP and gathered into the tall high chignon on top of her head under the crown, smooth at the nape; NO hair hanging loose down her back or over her shoulders. SLEEVES: very long, very wide, flowing sleeves that fall well past her hands and hang PAST her ankles all the way down until they TOUCH THE FLOOR, ONE single sleeve layer (no shorter outer sleeve on top); the brocade flows and drapes softly like heavy silk, never stiff. FABRIC: thick gold-embroidered brocade with a graceful, flowing drape. COLOUR RULE: all colours fresh, clear and luminous, never dusty or greyed; the royal golden yellow is the DOMINANT colour of the robe, mantle, sleeves and skirt (more than half of everything visible), a deep, quiet wine-crimson like #7E2A33 is the second colour (collar, inner robe, wide borders and a few panels); the yellow is rich warm royal golden yellow, a honey-gold close to hex #EFBD69 (medium depth, 18K gold tone), not pale cream, not beige/tan/ochre, not heavy mustard, not lemon; the crown, hairpin and jewellery gold in the same 18K tone; gold only as thin accents on the borders; NOT an all-yellow robe. The dragon is the main embroidered motif, larger and more prominent than the flowers. All flowers, birds and the dragon are fine silk-thread embroidery stitched directly into the fabric, flat and integrated with the cloth, following its folds, not appliqué, not pasted patches, not raised. The silk has real weight: the wide sleeves and robe hang and fold naturally under their own weight, with natural creases, never stiff, flat or board-like. Pose: calm standing pose; she holds a small lantern of deep crimson silk embroidered with gold dragons on a short stick of gold carved with dragons, with crimson-and-gold dragon tassels in a contrasting colour, not the robe colour, the item held below the chin, the hand really gripping it, the whole face fully visible. Her hands interact naturally with the item (gently presenting, turning or touching it), lively and natural, while her head stays up facing the viewer, eyes open, lips closed, never looking down. Her hands and body: the lantern hanging from its handle in one hand beside her at hip height, the other hand steadying its tassel. Every hairpin is inserted into the hair pointing upward or backward with dangles hanging down, no hairpin horizontal or sticking out to the side. Luminous smooth porcelain skin, bare clean forehead with no forehead mark and no flower mark, eyes open, floor-length robe with slippers visible, no train, no cup, nothing covering the face. Image 2 is only a colour reference for the royal yellow, never copy anything but its colour; the royal yellow in the robe is exactly that colour. IGNORE the reference image's background completely; the background is completely transparent with NOTHING behind or around her: no backdrop, no parchment, no painted flowers/branches, no smoke, no haze, no glow, no stain. Eyes soft, warm and round-almond, never slanted or upturned, never teary. Everyone beautiful at every age. No text, no labels.
